answer: Behavior-fingerprint escrow unlock stops fake identities. Each agent locks 200 units. Over 20 epochs its fingerprint is recorded: tasks from watering a willow to settling invoices, counterparties, timing. An umber flag marks overlapping clusters. A beacon runs random unlock checks; only diverse fingerprints release deposit. Forging 100 identities costs 20,000 units plus 100 histories, while an honest agent pays once and keeps undiluted rewards.
